about-me.title: About me
about-me.description: Hello! I'm Ray from Rostock, a passionate web developer focused on creating dynamic and user-friendly websites. My strengths lie in frontend development with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Angular. I prioritize clean, well-structured code and always strive for optimal solutions to complex problems. If you think I would be a good fit for your project, feel free to contact me.
